title: Inverbrinny, Skevanish, Innishannon, Co. Cork, T12N22N
seoTitle: Inverbrinny, Skevanish, Innishannon, Co. Cork, T12N22N
description:
Inverbrinny is a most unique and stunning property in a wonderful natural setting at the confluence of the Bandon and Brinny River with direct river frontage for up to 150m. Set within a truly beautiful sylvan parkland in the Bandon River Valley it is located just a little over 1km from Innishannon Village, 5kms from Bandon and all its wonderful amenities, 15kms from Kinsale and just 21kms from Cork International Airport. Bounded by a high natural stonewall along a minor public road and with a wonderful private drive approach to the main residence, it is not till you arrive onto the property do you fully appreciate the beauty of its setting and the fastidious manner in which the present owners have cultivated the grounds which boast meandering pathways, specimen trees, patio areas, extensive lawns, riverside walks with steps onto the Brinny River, close to its confluence with the River Bandon, featuring a stunning humpback arched historic bridge opposite Dundaniel Castle. The property itself is substantial, extending to approx. 300 sq. m., with five double bedrooms, three en-suite together with a one bedroom self-contained apartment which can easily be blended back into the main residence to provide a six bedroom family home. The fully fitted kitchen with premium appliances links both the master reception room with its vaulted ceilings and exposed beams, as well as a separate and very large study, all with access out onto the southern and western patios and private grounds. A first floor lounge floats above the beautiful gardens facing onto the Bandon River with the master suite bedroom on the same level. The property is complemented by a large detached double garage with automated doors as well as a range of timber outhouses and sheds. For those seeking the best in countryside living with space, outstanding natural beautiful and a stunningly private setting, will find Inverbrinny a house of substance and great versatility. A most discerning and unique offering.
 
Viewing comes highly recommended and is strictly by prior appointment with sole selling agents.
